# Dedication

To the landowners who sat across the table and trusted us with their land, their questions, and their patience while we got the details right.

To the title professionals, surveyors, environmental consultants, and legal counsel whose painstaking, often invisible work is the reason a project closes instead of collapsing — this book exists to make your expertise visible to the people who depend on it.

To the development teams in the field, who turn a signed lease into a working power plant, one permit and one curative document at a time.

And to everyone earlier in their career in this industry: may this book save you a few of the expensive mistakes the rest of us had to learn the hard way.
